$comment: Modes: off | warn | block. Read by infra/ci/quality-gate.mjs from the Code quality workflow. Promote a gate to block once its warnings have proved trustworthy; see docs/guides/code-quality.md.

packageCoverage.description: Every changed package must still meet the coverage thresholds in its own vitest.config.ts. Packages are discovered from the diff, so a new package is covered as soon as it defines thresholds.

patchCoverage.description: At least 80% of the executable lines this pull request adds or changes must run under a test. Package-wide coverage can stay high while a pull request adds an untested branch; this measures the pull request itself.

complexity.description: Changed code stays readable: cyclomatic complexity, nesting depth, function length and parameter count. When a limit is genuinely wrong for a function, say why in an eslint-disable comment on that line.

prTitle.description: The pull request title becomes the squash-merge commit on main, so it must be a Conventional Commit, e.g. "fix(sessions): revoke refresh tokens on logout".
